You're disturbing my customers.|A kingpin, to Colby and Niro||audio=DisturbingCustomers.mp3}} During the [[Republic Era]], a [[Gender|male]] [[Duros]] '''kingpin''' owned secret casino in the back of [[The Corner Shop]] on the [[planet]] of [[Duro]]. At some point between c. [[62 BBY]] and [[33 BBY]], [[Cad Bane's gang|Lazlo's gang]] heisted the kingpin's establishment, with the [[youngling]]s [[Cad Bane|Colby]] and [[Niro]] distracting the casino owner as a diversion. The kingpin gave chase after the youthful distractors, only to be [[Blaster|gunned]] down by [[Lazlo]] before he could catch them. ==Biography== {{Quote|Yeah, we know that place. The owner, though, he… he doesn't like us.''"
"''Yeah? Well, I don't like him. He's got a little operation in there that's messing with my business interests.|Colby and Lazlo||audio=MessingWithInterests.mp3}} A [[Gender|male]] [[Duros]] kingpin took the possession of a [[Unidentified casino (Duro)|casino]]{{TOTU|The Good Life}} {{Subtitles|Disney+}} by some [[time]] between c. [[62 BBY]] and [[33 BBY]]. The establishment was located in the back of [[The Corner Shop]] on the [[planet]] of [[Duro]], and its customers needed to wander through the shopping aisles to reach the entry door. The man surrounded himself with individuals who assisted him when welcoming the newcomers or when tossing some customers out through a door that backed onto a dark street alley. In addition, he utilized [[security droid]]s to deal with troublemakers. [[File:KingpinConfrontsKids.png|thumb|right|250px|The kingpin confronts Colby and Niro.]] At some point between c. 62 [['ABY-BBY' dating system|BBY]] and 33 BBY, the Duros casino owner tossed out a [[Unidentified Rodian casino customer|Rodian customer]] through a backdoor that faced a dark alley. The kingpin told the man to scram and waited in the company of a [[Unidentified Twi'lek casino worker|Twi'lek worker]] until the patron ran away. As the [[Rodian]] dashed away, the casino owner screamed for them not to come back until they paid their debts. The incident was witnessed by two [[Duros]] street [[Youngling|children]], [[Cad Bane|Colby]] and [[Niro]]. When one of the boys accidentally bumped a bottle, the kingpin turned around and started telling off the younglings, who countered his lecture by blowing a raspberry. With the boys having run out of his view, the kingpin and his [[Twi'lek]] companion went back inside the casino. Meanwhile, the boys had caught the interest of the local [[bounty hunter]] [[Lazlo]]. The man gifted them a [[Currency|coin]] that they would use in The Corner Shop, just where the secret casino was located. While the younglings were busy picking up their products, an [[Aqualish]] [[Unidentified Aqualish shopkeeper|clerk]] watched as a [[Unidentified human casino customer|human casino customer]] walked down the shop aisle to knock at the backdoor. The kingpin scanned the newcomer through a viewhole before allowing him in and welcoming him back, with the same Twi'lek casino worker standing right beside him. The following morning, the boys were recruited by Lazlo to create a diversion so that he and his [[Cad Bane's gang|gang]] could heist the casino. The bounty hunter argued that the casino owner's operation impeded his business interests. Colby and Niro agreed to the deal, believing that the owner did not like them. In the evening, the kingpin had greeted the same [[human]] customer again, wishing him more luck than he had had the previous day. [[File:ADeadKingpin.png|thumb|left|250px|The kingpin's corpse]] At the same time, Colby and Niro started to cause trouble in the back alley by throwing garbage at the backdoor and otherwise making noise. The Duros kingpin shortly came to the scene and scolded the younglings, accusing them of disturbing his customers. When one of the boys laughed, the casino owner whistled for two security [[droid]]s, failing to notice as Lazlo's gang sneaking behind his very back. It was not until he heard some clamor inside that the kingpin had his droid re-enter the building to deal with the intruders. As the gang fled down the street, Colby and Niro rushed to join them, and the casino owner gave chase, screaming for them to get back. When he was about to exit the alley, Lazlo emerged from behind an adjacent building wall and [[Blaster|gunned]] him down with a single blaster shot, causing him to groan as he collapsed to the ground. The boys kept staring at the dead man's body before they joined Lazlo's gang again. ==Personality and traits== {{Quote|Hey, welcome back. Hope you have more luck this time, huh?'' [chuckles]''|The kingpin to a customer||audio=WelcomeBack.mp3}} The kingpin was a [[Color|blue]]-skinned and red-[[eye]]d Duros man with a stout build who earned money by running a secret casino. ==Equipment== In the last [[Standard day|days]] of his life, the kingpin was dressed in [[earth]]-toned [[Clothing|garment]]s, including a darker top underneath a lighter, high-collared jacket and a pair of trousers held up by a waist belt. ==Behind the scenes== The kingpin first appeared in the "[[The Good Life]]," an episode of the animated television miniseries ''[[Star Wars: Tales of the Underworld]]'', which was released on [[May 4]], [[2025]].{{SWYouTube|GkywNANueew|Tales of the Underworld | Official Trailer | Available May 4 on Disney+}} The character was voiced by [[David W. Collins ]] and was referred to as "kingpin" in end credits, while the episode's subtitles on [[Disney+]] mostly referred to him as a "casino owner." ==Appearances== *{{TOTU|The Good Life}} {{1st}} ==Notes and references== {{Mediacat|imagecat=Images of unidentified kingpin|soundcat=Audio files of unidentified kingpin}} {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |ka=ბანდის უცნობი უფროსი }} [[Category:Crime lords]] [[Category:Duros]] [[Category:Individuals with he/him pronouns]] [[Category:Males]]
